mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the number of resources (personnel or equipment) affected by a given event or by repeated events over time."
Remember that exposure is the number of resources (personnel or equipment) affected by a given event or by repeated events over time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tax placed by governments on commodities that are shipped into a country from a foreign country."
An import tariff is a tax placed by governments on commodities that are shipped into a country from a foreign country.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statistical measure of variability based on all of the values for yields or prices, not just the high, low, and average."
The coefficient of variation is a statistical measure of variability based on all of the values for yields or prices, not just the high, low, and average.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the on-farm strategies of risk management."
Diversification of farm business income is one of the on-farm strategies of risk management.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the obligations for cash costs, taxes, loan repayment, and family living expenses that must be met each year."
Cash flow requirements are the obligations for cash costs, taxes, loan repayment, and family living expenses that must be met each year.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set tax on a product, and this tax is the same on all products of its kind."
A specific tariff is a set tax on a product, and this tax is the same on all products of its kind.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the factors that determine the willingness of a farmer to bear risks."
Farm's total investment is one of the factors that determine the willingness of a farmer to bear risks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mathematically derived value which weights the outcomes by their respective probabilities."
The expected value is a mathematically derived value which weights the outcomes by their respective probabilities.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the production of food, feed, fiber and other products by the systematic growing and harvesting of plants and rearing of animals to sustain life."
Agriculture can be defined as the production of food, feed, fiber and other products by the systematic growing and harvesting of plants and rearing of animals to sustain life.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only formal agricultural insurance company in Nigeria and their scope of operations is limited compare with scope of operations of agricultural insurance in developed countries."
NAIC is the only formal agricultural insurance company in Nigeria and their scope of operations is limited compare with scope of operations of agricultural insurance in developed countries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most frequent or most likely if outcomes are normally distributed, but the average does not provide information about variability."
The average outcome is the most frequent or most likely if outcomes are normally distributed, but the average does not provide information about variability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to supplement farm incomes thereby reduce income variability."
Incomes from off- farm employment are used to supplement farm incomes thereby reduce income variability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the making of an overall judgment on the importance of a risk, to determine its acceptability."
Risk evaluation is the making of an overall judgment on the importance of a risk, to determine its acceptability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a privilege and not a right; hence farmers cannot expect them always."
Calamities relief by the government is a privilege and not a right; hence farmers cannot expect them always.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to risks that take place in an atmosphere of imperfect knowledge."
Uncertainty refers to risks that take place in an atmosphere of imperfect knowledge.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for bad harvests all over the world."
Drought or excess rain is responsible for bad harvests all over the world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known as idiosyncratic risk while risks that affect large number of farms are known as systemic risk."
Risks that affect few farms are known as idiosyncratic risk while risks that affect large number of farms are known as systemic risk.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a strategy that is adopted before the occurrence of risk in the farm."
Risk mitigation is a strategy that is adopted before the occurrence of risk in the farm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an ever-present risk and one of the most common causes of food insecurity."
Conflict is an ever-present risk and one of the most common causes of food insecurity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the essence of best educated opinions and available statistics as the primary sources of information."
Herein is the essence of best educated opinions and available statistics as the primary sources of information.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the categorisation of the type of risk being considered-for example, weather, price, pest, policy, or market."
Hazard is the categorisation of the type of risk being considered-for example, weather, price, pest, policy, or market.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used by government to combat price risk vis-à-vis production risk."
Price stabilisation policies are used by government to combat price risk vis-à-vis production risk.
